title: get_raw NotFound formats CID with bs58 not cid.to_string()
description: crates/reader/src/post/rocks_store.rs:92 — get_raw encodes the NotFound CID via bs58::encode(&cid_bytes) where cid_bytes is the raw multi-byte CID encoding. This produces a non-standard base58 string that does not match canonical CIDv1 format (base32 lowercase). A user seeing this error and trying to look up the CID in any IPFS tool or log will see a different string. The fix: compute cid.to_string() before moving into the spawn_blocking closure. The jitter: cid_bytes is already moved into the closure so cid is gone; computing the string first is the cleanest fix.
